broker.name: Hantec Markets
broker.tagline: Its site names 5 regulators, including FSC (Mauritius), FCA, and ASIC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:500.
broker.about: The Hantec Markets pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Hantec Global, Hantec Pro, and Hantec Cent. Platforms named there include Hantec Mobile, Hantec WebTrader, Hantec Social, MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, and PAMM. The site names these regulators: FSC (Mauritius), FCA, ASIC, VFSC, and HGX. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:500. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSC (Mauritius): Hantec Markets Limited, C114013940. FCA: Hantec Markets Limited, 502635. ASIC. VFSC. HGX.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage https://www.hmarkets.com fetched on 2026-10-11. About page says the Hantec Group was founded in 1990 and that the brand is regulated in six jurisdictions. It names FSC Mauritius, ASIC, VFSC, Financial Services Authority (FSA) and Hong Kong Gold Exchange (HGX), plus 'others', but does not give licence numbers for ASIC, VFSC, FSA or HGX, and does not say which country's FSA. Mauritius licence C114013940 is on the policies page and the Mauritius retail terms PDF. UK FCA 502635 is on the UK retail terms PDF hosted on hmarkets.com. No separate broker incorporation year or headquarters city was stated on the fetched about page. No priced client promotion was found.
_notes.company_details_not_listed: Mauritius policies page: Hantec Markets Limited, authorised by the Mauritius FSC, licence C114013940. UK retail terms PDF on hmarkets.com: Hantec Markets Limited, FCA firm reference 502635, address Second Floor, 11-21 Paul Street, London EC2A 4JU. The about page does not give a company number.
